Markets.title: Investor sentiment plunges to 16-month low, AAII survey shows
Markets.summary: Investor sentiment dropped to a 16-month low in the latest AAII survey, with bearish investors rising to 53.3%. Elevated oil prices, a Federal Reserve rate hike, and market volatility drove this caution among individual investors.

Markets.title: Howard Buffett to take charge as Berkshire Hathaway chairman: Who is he?
Markets.summary: Howard Buffett, a 71-year-old Berkshire Hathaway board member of 33 years, will succeed his father, Warren Buffett, as the company's chairman. He has a diverse career background spanning farming, conservation, business, law enforcement, and philanthropy.

Markets.title: Global Markets: French bond spread at highest since 2012 as default insurance spikes
Markets.summary: Risk premiums on French government bonds and default insurance have surged to their highest levels since 2012 due to mounting investor concerns over the nation's fiscal health and upcoming elections. France is now planning a major savings initiative to address its widening budget deficit, which has also impacted French banking stocks.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields rise as investors weigh outlook for rate hikes
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields have risen as investors anticipate further interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. This uptick coincides with the Bank of Japan raising rates to a 31-year high amid escalating global inflation pressures.

Markets.title: HDFC Mutual Fund buys 13.9 lakh Entero Healthcare shares from Prasid Uno Family Trust in Rs 236 crore block deal
Markets.summary: HDFC Mutual Fund purchased 1.39 million shares of Entero Healthcare Solutions for Rs 235.6 crore in a block deal. The shares, representing a 3.19% stake, were sold by Prasid Uno Family Trust at Rs 1,695 per share.

Geo-Political.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
Geo-Political.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron stated that Russian hybrid attacks against Europe are increasing in frequency. He has directed his government to enhance security at critical infrastructure and defense industry sites.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
Geo-Political.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced that he is banning reporters from CNN and Politico from the White House. This action escalates his historically tense and confrontational relationship with the American news media.

Geo-Political.title: Is the Kennedy Center losing 'hundreds of millions of dollars'?
Geo-Political.summary: Financial records from 2024 show that the Kennedy Center did not lose hundreds of millions of dollars. Instead, the venue recorded a surplus of millions of dollars after factoring in contributions and grants.

Geo-Political.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
Geo-Political.summary: An explosives-laden vehicle rammed into a Pakistan mosque, killing at least 21 people, including a four-year-old child. Gunmen also opened fire on a nearby police facility during the attack.

Geo-Political.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
Geo-Political.summary: A holdout juror in the Lindsay Clancy trial has spoken publicly for the first time about his decision. He stated that he had no doubt Clancy deliberately killed her children and refused to vote for an acquittal.

Geo-Political.title: Ryanair boss Michael O'Leary apologises over 'high-fare rapists' remarks
Geo-Political.summary: Ryanair CEO Michael O'Leary apologized for using the term "high-fare rapists" during a press conference. He described his choice of words as careless and promised the remark will not happen again.

Data & Insights.title: States need to raise capex to 3% of GSDP by FY32 for developed India: Revenue secretary
Data & Insights.summary: Revenue Secretary Arvind Shrivastava stated that Indian states must increase their capital expenditure to 3% of GSDP by FY32. This spending boost is essential for achieving a developed economy status by 2047 through improved fiscal management and private investment.

Data & Insights.title: India needs more savings, private capital to sustain 7-8% growth, says N.K. Singh
Data & Insights.summary: Former finance commission chairman N.K. Singh stated that India must increase domestic savings and private capital to maintain a 7-8% economic growth rate. Achieving this target also requires improved capital allocation and stronger fiscal coordination between the central and state governments.

Data & Insights.title: Net direct tax collections rise 13% to  ₹12.1 trillion
Data & Insights.summary: Net direct tax collections increased by 13% to reach ₹12.1 trillion. Meanwhile, net corporate tax collections saw a growth of 19.48% after accounting for refunds.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why India and Canada are pitching for a CEPA by end-2026
Data & Insights.summary: India and Canada are aiming to finalize a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) by the end of 2026. This initiative is designed to strengthen their economic ties after a recent period of strained diplomatic relations.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's raises India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7% on Middle East resilience, but risks remain
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's raised India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7% on Friday, citing resilience despite Middle East tensions. However, the ratings agency warned that elevated energy prices and El Niño-related food inflation pose ongoing risks to consumption and growth.

Data & Insights.title: Centre to hold state finance ministers’ conference ahead of GST Council meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The Centre will host a conference for state finance ministers on "Financing India’s Journey towards Viksit Bharat" ahead of the October 7 GST Council meeting. Additionally, pre-budget meetings for the Union Budget 2027-28 are scheduled to officially begin on October 12.

India.summary: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju dismissed the opposition as disgruntled relatives who are frustrated by their inability to win elections. He also highlighted the ongoing development in India's Northeast region during his remarks at NDTV's People's Sansad.

India.title: "We Respect Other Forms Of Worship": RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat In Ujjain
India.summary: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat stated that the organization respects all forms of worship while speaking at the Yuva Dharma Sansad in Ujjain. He also expressed happiness at seeing Generation Z actively discussing dharma.

India.title: Peculiar Symbol, CCTV Footage: Inside Delhi Police Probe In Rape-Murder Case
India.summary: Delhi Police are investigating the rape and fatal stabbing of a 15-to-17-year-old girl by four suspects. Investigators are examining CCTV footage and a peculiar symbol found in connection with the case after her body was dumped in an open field.

India.title: Mamata Banerjee Drew Her Party's Symbol By Hand. It's Now Tied To An Indira Gandhi Case
India.summary: Mamata Banerjee hand-drew her party's current election symbol, which is now linked to a historical dispute resolution process. This method was established during the 1969 Indian National Congress split when Indira Gandhi contested party leadership.

India.title: Punjab Government Announces 8% DA Hike Ahead Of 2027 Polls
India.summary: The Punjab government has announced an 8 percent Dearness Allowance (DA) hike ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. This decision comes amid a history of contentious relations between the state government and its employees.

General.title: 'I'm telling the truth': Earl Spencer defends Diana book claims about Charles in BBC interview
General.summary: In a BBC interview, Earl Spencer defended claims made in his book about Princess Diana. He stated that the then-Prince of Wales literally said "we'll forget her soon enough" regarding Diana.

General.title: Watch: Diana's brother says Charles 'went ballistic' in phone call after her death
General.summary: In a new book and interview, Earl Spencer claimed that then-Prince Charles "went ballistic" during a phone call following Princess Diana's death. Spencer shared these details during an exclusive discussion with BBC broadcaster Laura Kuenssberg.

General.title: MI5 accepts it gave evidence based on lies in neo-Nazi spy case
General.summary: MI5 has acknowledged that it gave evidence based on lies in court while defending a violent neo-Nazi informant. This marks the first time the security service has confirmed these revelations.

General.summary: A software defect lasting one millisecond caused widespread flight chaos. The incident resulted in over 2,000 canceled flights and affected hundreds of thousands of passengers.

General.title: Teen who piloted Channel boat with 165 migrants jailed
General.summary: Chan Mathok Atak has been sentenced to two years and three months in prison. He was convicted of piloting a boat carrying 165 migrants across the Channel.
